description: This file contains the controller class 'AOR_ChartsController' for handling specific actions related to charts in the SuiteCRM module, notably the 'getImageMap' function. It includes logic for generating and caching image map data for a chart.

classes.name: AOR_ChartsController
classes.description: Controller class for managing chart-related actions, extending the SugarController base class.

methods.name: action_getImageMap
methods.description: Handles the request to generate and output an image map for a chart. It initializes an image object, verifies request parameters, and triggers the image map dump process.
